## Which part is squared? {#recall}

::: {.kicker}
Lesson 1 · Integer index laws
:::

Simplify $\displaystyle\frac{(2a^3)^2}{4a^2}$ on paper. Assume all variables in this lesson are non-zero.

<details name="recall-working">
<summary>Reminder</summary>

The power outside the brackets acts on every factor inside. When you divide powers with the same base, subtract their indices.

</details>

<details name="recall-working">
<summary>Check my working</summary>

$(2a^3)^2=2^2(a^3)^2=4a^6$. Dividing gives $\dfrac{4a^6}{4a^2}=a^{6-2}=a^4$. Check that you squared the coefficient as well as the power.

</details>

<details name="recall-working">
<summary>Try a similar question</summary>

Simplify $\dfrac{(3t^2)^2}{3t}$. Write the numerator on a separate line.

</details>

<details name="recall-working">
<summary>Check the retry</summary>

$\dfrac{9t^4}{3t}=3t^{4-1}=3t^3$.

</details>
